ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) distribution across >95% of visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixel clusters restricted to distal lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black contiguous region mapping to the central and medial fluke surface. High-contrast, irregularly shaped white clusters (mottling) mapped to coordinates at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an acute angle and significant bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to high-frequency, jagged serrations and pixel peaks at the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to narrow distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters localized exclusively on the distal lateral margins of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant localized white scarring and presumed barnacle-related pigmentation disruption at the outer tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast alphanumeric metadata in the lower portion of the image frame ('KCB 77/ 20', '10173', 'KEN BALCOMB', '20 Aug 87').
